summary: Senior Web Developer with 10+ years of professional software development and 7+ years of hands-on React and TypeScript for Walmart Global Tech (retail and marketplace platforms), IBM/AEP and HCSC. Architects and scales enterprise-grade web applications with React and Next.js (App Router, Server Components, SSR/SSG/ISR rendering strategies) and designs micro-frontend architectures where independently deployed fragments compose into one shell. Leads governance of enterprise UI component libraries, design tokens and frontend standards; scalable CSS with SCSS, CSS Modules and Tailwind; WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility and i18n for global users; performance work with Webpack, Vite and Turbopack. Quality through Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress and Playwright, with canary and blue/green releases on CI/CD. Daily use of Claude Code and GitHub Copilot, plus Cursor.
